articles.title: It's Not Just Royal Jelly: The Wax in a Queen Bee's Crib Matters Too
articles.summary: Scientists discovered that the wax in a queen bee's cell is softer, less dense, and chemically different from worker cell wax. This special wax, built by 'royal nurses,' may help turn a larva into a queen.

articles.title: After a 24-Day Ocean Ordeal, SpaceX's Starship Floats to Christmas Island
articles.summary: SpaceX's Ship 40, the first Starship upper stage to survive an ocean splashdown intact, has been towed to calmer waters near Christmas Island after a 24-day journey. Engineers will now inspect it to improve future flights.

articles.title: What If the Cosmos Evolves Like a Living Organism?
articles.summary: A niche theory called 'cosmological evolution' suggests universes reproduce through black holes and evolve over generations. Once dismissed, the idea is gaining attention thanks to a writer and new telescope data.
